name: Neon Grid 3D
description: Synthwave 3D style: dark navy matte bodies with cyan rim edges, bloom on glowing parts, depth fog and a low camera that glides and rises. A style only: any grid floor, towers, sun or props are built by the agent from custom world parts for each video. No emoji.
prompt_hint: 6-10 scenes (3-5 s). Each: title.kicker + title.main, visual.type "scene3d" with a `world` (ground kind grid or mirror, backdrop, parts) and `custom` objects built from scratch for THIS video; use glowing parts (role glow, material emissive), fx glow/sweep/spotlight and camera `shots`. No emoji.
